column3: rationale
Three synthetic requests establish request-to-accepted counts, within-window outcome and exact nearest-rank waits
Completed work without a farmer decision is counted separately, not treated as accepted
Duplicate request identities would inflate or collapse denominators
Request and assessment scope must be identical
Stale service records cannot support a current-period access result
A quote without full price terms is not countable as a valid offer
Bookings require a complete, not-expired quote
Physical completion without a recorded booking is invalid in this versioned contract
Lifecycle timestamps must be monotone
A no-show reason without a booking is inconsistent
Quote fee basis must match requested service unit
Separate travel charge must be visible rather than hidden
Digest syntax must be valid before source-referenced records are admitted
Sub-k cohort names and values must be omitted from output
A single consented cohort of size ten is eligible for aggregate output
Labels must not be retained in this output without explicit aggregation consent
Displayed cohort threshold cannot be configured below ten
Missing is not equivalent to zero service or failure/success
Booking after quote validity must be blocked
